paragraphs: Omicron Technology Solutions lists Focus Identity Management as tools to manage identity for students, staff, and visitors. TransitME is offered as Configurable Software as a Service to digitally transform special fare administration. ConnectNow covers teacher collaboration and communication for IEPs, 504, and ISP plans. Custom Software Development and Customer Service & Back Office are also listed, the latter covering call center support and back office application processing.

Schools and universities are named for campus safety, where Focus is a web and cloud-based SaaS platform to maximize school safety for every student, teacher, and administrator. Public Transit Agencies are named as an industry, with TransitME described as eliminating manual, legacy, and paper processes that hinder access to riders with special fares. Cities and municipalities are named as another industry, and the CityID Platform allows a city to create custom CityIDs for residents.

quote.text: Developing Modern, Flexible, & Scalable Software to Simplify Complex Problems
